snippet.title: Ice Scream Tycoon 🍧​🥶 - Launch trailer 🎞
snippet.description:
The evil ice cream man Rod Sullivan, from the famous Keplerians saga, Ice Scream, has kidnapped you to be his minion. 

In this idle game you have the mission of making Rod's factory work, while Rod Sullivan is doing his evils, chasing J or fattening children, but don't worry because the Mini Rods will help you.
Keep an eye out, because from time to time Rod Sullivan will stop by the factory, which will speed up the production of the factory so you can get resources faster!

Ice Scream Tycoon is game developed by Campero Games in association with @KepleriansTeamGames 

Download it for FREE on iOS and Android:

🔸Google Play: 
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.camperogames.icescream.rodfactory
🔹App Store:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ice-scream-tycoon/id1628807355
